coordinates: Original source/reference.png pixels, x rightward and y downward; r is character right/viewer left.
method: PrepareBrows.java extracts only dark original eyebrow ink in a narrow curved band against per-column upper/lower source samples. Positive bright residuals and measured hair-line crossings remain in the stationary head base. No new character drawing or image generation is used.
neutral_constraint: The same patch boundary and selected pixels are used for base and foreground. Their neutral composite must reconstruct the source within 8-bit rounding; check actual rendered images as well.
limits: The source uses light eyebrows drawn across the bangs; their original translucent anime appearance is intentional.
Vertical Y motion uses the existing eyebrow mechanism, without independent angle or shape parameters.
Closely inspect hair-line intersections and ensure the compensating base does not move with the eyebrow.
